title: Audit: M6 T36 EmulationStation's utilities, resources and renderers -- 10 findings (independent; L-19 + 4 seat-found memory-safety/data-loss)
body:
Independent audit (depth: independent, one seat GPT-6 Astra at max) of EmulationStation's `es-core/src/{utils,resources,renderers}` slice at the pin `16dbac5211`. Artifacts: `docs/audits/2026_10_31-epic-m6-es-core-utils-resources/` (`00`..`05`, `second-opinions/`, `stage-a`..`stage-c`, `guest-cycle`, `tools`).

**Verdict (seat):** "usable as a starting punch list, not sound unchanged." L-19 confirmed on the VM; three positives in `02` corrected; 21 missed findings, four re-verified at the pin (G-1, G-9, G-16, G-4). Pre-issue lint PASS.

## Punch items (acceptance checklist)

Each item is an observed VM artifact or a verified pin read; a bug is filed per defect item (below).

- [x] PL-01 (Medium, L-01/3.1/G-8): `toUpper`/`toLower` fold multi-byte codepoints byte-wise; the casing tables are unsafe — fixed and the case passes (`stage-c/build-tests.out` shows 3.1 FAIL at the pin)
- [x] PL-02 (Medium, L-03/3.2): `copyFile` returns true over an absent source and a short write — fixed, 3.2 passes
- [x] PL-03 (Medium, L-19/3.26/G-11): `removeFile` leaves the deleted path cached as present — fixed (unlink before erase), 3.26 passes
- [x] PL-04 (Low, L-16/3.15/G-15): `createDirectory` races to false and accepts an existing file — fixed, cases pass
- [x] PL-05 (Medium, L-12/3.13/#1263): cache reads an outside writer can stale are forced uncached — fixed, #1263's frame or unit case
- [x] PL-06 (High, G-1): a failed font-atlas allocation leaves a dangling pointer in `mTextures` — fixed, ASan case clean
- [x] PL-07 (High, G-9): a date format over 256 bytes overruns a stack buffer — fixed, over-long-format case bounded
- [x] PL-08 (High, G-16): `copyFile` onto the same inode destroys the source — fixed, hard-link case refused
- [x] PL-09 (Medium, G-4): `loadFromPdf` returns false after a successful load — fixed, one-page fixture returns true
- [x] PL-10 (#1368): six Resolved G-items fixed in S10 (ES `9c1bd5f09`, dist `818aa0c156`) -- G-3/G-6/G-10/G-14/G-20 verified by host ASan/behaviour FAIL-at-pin then PASS; **G-7's FAIL-at-pin positive is synthetic (the underflow only hits SSO strings ASan cannot see, so the decoder bounds are lifted over a heap buffer), with a behaviour control over ""/"a" on the real function -- this box stays partial under the synthetic-input rule until a real input is seen once**; the five leaks/races/classifications (G-2, G-5, G-12, G-13, G-21) Deferred to Backlog #1372

## Carried / owed

- The stand-in's four T36 fakes (Font/FreeType, TextureData/vlc, the three renderers/GLES3) and the renderers positive under `-DUSE_OPENGLES_30`.
- `es-unit-tests` retried with the build root's rapidjson before any CANNOT (`02` § The runs).
- Three held findings (D-WORKFLOW-215) filed as neutral public bugs separately.

Punch list detail and proposed dispositions: `05-punch-list.md`. Second opinion: `04-analysis.md` § Second opinion.
